description: Retrieve FIRST Championship advancement for regional (non-district) teams in a season, keyed by team key. Each entry says whether the team qualified, its status (NotInvited, PreQualified, EventQualified, PoolQualified, Declined), and how: qualifying event key and award name, or the regional pool week of its invitation. Only available for 2025 and later; earlier years return an error.

year.description: FRC competition season year. FRC began in 1992 and runs one game per year (e.g., 2023 = "Charged Up", 2024 = "Crescendo", 2025 = "Reefscape"). Must be between 1992 and next calendar year.

name: get_regional_advancement
title: Get Regional Championship Advancement
